title: Duskwing the Shadow Dragon
story: Duskwing the Shadow Dragon can only be fought in the light — in darkness he simply vanishes. Mr 6's enchanted lantern burns 1/4 of its oil every battle round, and the old dragon-hunters' scrolls say Duskwing takes 6 full rounds to defeat.
question: How many full lanterns of oil must Mr 6 bring to keep the light burning all 6 rounds?
hint: If a lantern burns 1/4 each round, one lantern lasts 4 rounds. Is that enough for 6 rounds? If not, how many lanterns cover it?
victory: Two lanterns blaze through all six rounds! With nowhere to hide, Duskwing shrinks to the size of a house cat and curls up in the empty lantern — Mr 6 now has a night-light with wings.
